matches.rationale: No finding mentions ShapeLLM, the 3D MLLM backbone, or the claimed affordance/instruction-decomposition capabilities of Section 3.1; all findings concern diffusion equations, losses, guidance scale, FID derivative and p-values.

No finding identifies the logical contradiction between the 'training-free' refinement claim, the iterative gradient-based loss optimization and the classifier-free guidance training-time masking. Pred 2 touches the spherical Gaussian constraint equation but flags a distinct formula-normalization error, and Pred 6 flags a guidance-scale range violation — both different scientific issues (R4).
